executive.summary: El mercado de motos mantiene un crecimiento muy superior a la actividad general. El principal límite sigue siendo la capacidad de pago: tasas minoristas, empleo e ingreso disponible.

macro.detail: Latest official inflation remains below the first-half pace. This helps nominal affordability, although household budgets are still tight.
The latest INDEC wage index continues to show nominal recovery. Keep the signal positive but avoid overstating real-income improvement until same-month inflation and employment are aligned.
The latest hard activity data are weak. Motorcycle demand is outperforming the broader economy, so the model should not extrapolate market growth from GDP alone.
Labor-market softness remains a constraint on discretionary demand and reinforces the importance of accessible monthly payments.
The official FX is contained inside a wide intervention band. Imported-cost pressure is manageable in Base, but sensitivity remains relevant for imported models and components.
Benchmark rates are much lower than retail personal-loan rates. For motorcycles, effective dealer financing, savings plans and subsidized offers matter more than the policy-rate narrative.

micro.detail: +8.7% MoM and +35.7% YoY on the CAFAM close used by the app. YTD reached 672,710 units, +40.7% YoY.
CAFAM-reported composition was 78,015 national-origin units and 2,626 imported units. Supply analysis should still track imported components and model-specific import flows separately.
72,538 units were reported in 101–250 cc, confirming that accessible mobility remains the engine of the market despite higher-cylinder seasonal upside.
National production, PGM-FI, CBS, LCD and USB-C. Track reservations, dealer stock and first registrations to separate CUB expansion from Wave cannibalization.
Fuel consumption Jan–Aug was reported 5.36% below 2023. Higher operating costs pressure households, but can strengthen the relative mobility advantage of low-consumption motorcycles versus cars.
September showed early rebound signals in electricity demand, tax-linked activity and consumer confidence. Treat as confirmation watch, not yet as a Base-forecast step-up.

planning_read.headline: Motorcycle demand is decoupling positively from weak hard-activity data, but affordability remains credit-sensitive.
planning_read.base: Keep October Base constructive because CAFAM closed September above 80k and seasonal demand is entering a stronger period.
planning_read.upside: Faster real-income improvement, effective financing and strong Biz/CUB conversion can push volume above the current seasonal path.
planning_read.downside: Weak employment/activity, expensive retail credit, FX repricing or fuel/household-budget stress can cap conversion even if traffic and leads remain strong.

forecast.method: Recent six-month deseasonalized level × robust 2010–2026 seasonal curve × decaying recent YoY signal
